[[File:Collecting-Encyclopedia-3.2-page-35.jpg|thumb|400px|Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2, page 35]]

The [[Star Wars CCG Collecting Encyclopedia]] 3.2, page 35, lists [[Premiere Unlimited]] Revisions.<ref name="enc35">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], page 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> [[Electrobinoculars]] has deploy cost and use cost placed in game text. [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]] has Owen Lars removed from game text. Unique unpiloted starships ([[Black 2]], [[Black 3]], [[Vader's Custom TIE]], [[Gold 1]], [[Gold 5]], [[Millennium Falcon]], and others) have the rule about requiring a pilot added to game text.

Each row is the Limited Decipher scan, an outer-ring recolor of that scan, and the Unlimited File already dested on the wiki.

== Starships named on page 35 ==

=== Millennium Falcon ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-millenniumfalcon.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan prints ship-docking capability and ends the box. The dested white-border photograph on [[Millennium Falcon (Unlimited)]] ([[File:Premiere-U-L-millenniumfalcon.jpg]]) prints an extra sentence: Must have a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

=== Red 3 ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-red3.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan prints May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. The dested white-border photograph on [[Red 3 (Unlimited)]] ([[File:Premiere-U-L-red3.jpg]]) prints an extra sentence: Must have a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

=== Gold 5 ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-gold5.jpg|800px]]

The Limited File ([[File:Premiere-L-gold5.gif]], Holotable D-E1 scan) prints May add 2 pilots or passengers, and 1 astromech. The existing Unlimited File ([[File:Premiere-U-L-gold5.jpg]]) prints an extra sentence: Must have a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed.

=== Gold 1 ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-gold1.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan already prints Must have a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed. The existing Unlimited File is a white-border copy of that same wording.

=== Red 1 ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-red1.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan already prints Must have a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed. The existing Unlimited File matches that wording.

=== Black 2 ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-black2.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan already prints Must have a pilot aboard to use power or maneuver. The existing Unlimited File matches that wording.

=== Black 3 ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-black3.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan already prints Must have a pilot aboard to use power or maneuver. The existing Unlimited File matches that wording.

=== Vader's Custom TIE ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-vaderscustomtie.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan already prints Must have a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver or hyperspeed. The existing Unlimited File matches that wording.

== Other page-35 Revisions ==

=== Electrobinoculars ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-electrobinoculars.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan and the existing Unlimited File both print Use 1 Force to deploy on any warrior. Both then print peek at the top card of the Reserve Deck by using 2 Force. Deploy cost and use cost sit in the game-text box on both.

=== Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm ===
[[File:Premiere-Unlimited-enc-check-tatooinelarsmoisturefarml.jpg|800px]]

The Limited Decipher scan and the existing Unlimited File both print Beru Lars and Luke deploy -1 here. Owen Lars is absent from both.
